trend: ADP Research 2026: nearly 1 in 4 Indian workers put in 16+ unpaid hours a week, the highest of any market surveyed
why: Fresh, numbers-led and about our exact audience. Matches the shape the team approved: hard number from a named study plus an honest line.
text:
Nearly 1 in 4 Indian workers put in 16 or more unpaid hours a week, the highest of every market in ADP's 2026 survey.

Those hours usually come out of sleep. If your week looks like this, protect one thing first: the same wake-up time every day, weekends included.
